_gui: true | false  (false = Gazebo server only, no window)
_world: blocks_world_long.sdf (table to x = 1.25 m, 3 towers at x = 0.85) | blocks_world.sdf | blocks_world_tjoin.sdf | absolute path to an .sdf
_view: start camera of the Gazebo window: 'x y z roll pitch yaw' (m, rad); read the current one with: gz topic -e -n 1 -t /gui/camera/pose
_camera: true | false  (wrist camera: adds the camera link to the robot, bridges /wrist_mounted_camera/image and /camera_info)
_moveit: true | false  (start move_group: collision-aware planning and IK)
_rviz: true | false  (RViz with the MoveIt layout; only with moveit true)
_physics: dart | bullet  (Gazebo physics engine. dart: Gazebo's default; the weld does not open the gripper, but one of the 2F-140's five mimic joints (left_inner_finger_joint) is not coupled. bullet: bullet-featherstone couples all mimic joints, but a weld makes the fingers drift open)
_position_gain: number > 0 | 0  (gz_ros2_control position_proportional_gain: joint velocity = gain * position error. Default of gz_ros2_control is 0.1, which tracks the 2F-140's mimic joints so softly that the finger linkage looks loose and a weld makes the fingers drift. 10 holds the linkage correct (tested with physics dart). 0 = leave the gz_ros2_control default)
_weld: true | false  (sim only: one Gazebo DetachableJoint per cube so the experiment can attach a cube to the gripper and release it; the launch detaches all cubes right after the robot is spawned)
